<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.34.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Add st.experimental_dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8040
* from_dict for query params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8470
* Improve period type support in `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7987
* Add ability to clear cache for specific function arguments by passing args to `<cached_func>.clear()` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8297
* Add support for autoplaying `st.audio` and `st.video` media by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8481
* Support background colors for text by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8435
* Non-emoji icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8307
* Add support for Modin and Snowpark Pandas by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8506
* Enable the usage of the pydeck-carto package with st.pydeck_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8422
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Offset dates in vega if no timezone information is attached. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8278
* Fix issues with fragments writing to containers and the sidebar by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8408
* Produce python error for slider min=max by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8413
* Make check for component ready dynamic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8434
* Update Auto Theme after print dialog if necessary by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8469
* Reset widget state on page change by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8425
* Switch back to using undeprecated pillow constant by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8492
* Fix double script/callback run when replacing a file by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8493
* Handle Altair vconcat with use_container_width by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8498
* Fix empty state for `st.status` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8369
* Fix `st.multiselect` usage with empty sets or tuples by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8471
* Handle Altair resolve_scale by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8497
* Adjust default date for st.date_input if today's date is out of bounds by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8519
* Handle setting session state keys to None for supported widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8529
* Fix empty generator usage with `st.write_stream` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8560
### Other Changes
* Update modal styles by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8274
* Move toasts to top right and make them prettier by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8433
* Fix escaping in docstrings by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8510
* Fix blank space print by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8502
* Remove snowflake extras python restriction by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8538

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8520
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8297

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.33.0...1.34.0
